data.narrative:
NextSilicon is a Series B-stage AI & Software company founded by Elad Raz that has raised $200M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private and 1 public company operating in AI infrastructure and software, including Scale AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, Palantir, Waymo, and public peer Palantir (PLTR).

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses total capital raised ($200M) as a valuation proxy, applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage step-ups, yielding $380M. The peer-median method benchmarks against three same-stage, same-sector comparables: Scale AI at $29.0B, Physical Intelligence at $5.6B, and Black Forest Labs at $3.2B. The median of this peer set is $5.6B, with a range spanning $3.2B to $29.0B.

The two methods produce a wide spread, implying a triangulated valuation range of $323M (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median of $3.0B. The peer-median method carries greater weight given the direct comparability of three operational companies at identical stage and sector. Key uncertainties include the substantial variance within the peer set—driven largely by Scale AI's outsized $29B valuation—and the lack of revenue or profitability data to calibrate quality-of-execution differences between NextSilicon and its comparables. A more refined range of $3.0B–$5.6B reflects the middle of the peer distribution.
